title: Entangled Devices
subtitle: Codes, owners, private and public
text:
Entangled devices that share a code are linked across any distance and any dimension. Write a code onto a Link Card in the Entangled Programmer, then right click a device with the card. Whoever wrote the card owns the devices it codes.

A public code is shared by everyone, and anything can use a public device: hoppers, other mods' pipes and any cable or generator next to it.

A private code belongs to its owner, so two players can both use 482913 without meeting. A private device only connects to Simple Machines pipes and cables placed by its owner. Hoppers and other mods' pipes do nothing, and a generator right next to it won't power it, so run your own cable. Pipes and cables placed before 2.2 have no owner: break them and place them again.

Only the owner can open a private device or change its code, and a private pad only teleports its owner. The owner switches a device between private and public with a screwdriver.
caption: Who can connect

steps.text: A device's tooltip and screen show its code and whether it is private or public.
Breaking a device keeps its code.
